notes.title: The Path of Ren: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
It's been a long time coming and a ton of work to get to this point, but I'm super excited to announce that The Path of Ren will be fully available on April 4th, 2025—as revealed in the official release announcement trailer that premiered today!

[previewyoutube=MfTkF-riRGU;full][/previewyoutube]

Steam Next Fest

With that release date set, The Path of Ren will also be participating in Steam Next Fest this February! More info on this is TBA.

Wishlist Now

Don’t forget to add The Path of Ren to your Steam wishlist to stay updated on future announcements! Wishlisting also helps a lot with the game's visibility at launch.

Thank you!

Thank you to everyone who's supported this project. I'm really looking forward to putting The Path of Ren out into the world! It's been a huge pleasure to create, but also one of the hardest things I've ever done.

I hope you enjoy it! 💙

- Trever (creator of The Path of Ren)
